title: Monomers
description: An array of monomer records used by the ProteinQure monomer database.

PQ_SYMBOL.description: Unique, user-visible ProteinQure identifier for the monomer.

IUPAC_CONDENSED.description: Condensed IUPAC name of the monomer.

IUPAC.description: Full systematic IUPAC name of the monomer.

TYPE.description: High-level monomer role: Backbone, N-term cap, C-term cap, or Modification.

CLASS.description: Backbone class, such as alpha, beta, gamma, delta, or epsilon; classes that only restate a terminal-cap type are displayed as blank in the UI.

ANALOG.description: Three-letter code of the monomer's canonical natural amino-acid analogue; X indicates no natural analogue.

MOL_WT.description: Average molecular weight of the free monomer, in daltons (Da).

LOGP.description: Calculated octanol/water partition coefficient (cLogP); higher values indicate greater lipophilicity. Unitless.

TPSA.description: Topological polar surface area (tPSA), in square ångströms (Å²); a proxy for hydrogen-bonding capacity and membrane permeability.

POPULARITY.description: Estimate of how widely the monomer is used, from 0 to 100, combining commercial availability with occurrences in public structure and bioactivity databases; treat it as a lower bound because unchecked sources count as zero.

PROTECTED.description: Whether at least one vendor-listed protected variant is available, represented as the uppercase string TRUE or FALSE.

SMILES.description: SMILES structure representation of the unprotected monomer.

INCHIKEY.description: Standard InChIKey used as an exact-match structure identifier.
